title: The representative-preserving comparison of abelian geometric stalks
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with geometric points s : Spec k → S and s' : Spec k' → S [def-weil-geometric-point], and a : Spec k → Spec k' satisfying a ≫ s' = s. For every abelian sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], there is exactly one group homomorphism F_s' → F_s between geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] whose composite with the coprojection at (U,t) equals the coprojection at (U,a ≫ t). Every homomorphism satisfying this formula is an isomorphism.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Remark 04FN (remark-map-stalks, line 3416): the canonical map of stalks of a morphism of geometric points, 'since the functor above is clearly an equivalence ... this canonical map is an isomorphism of stalk functors'; used in the paragraph before Definition 04FS (line 3984)

proof.text: Use the equivalence of pointed neighbourhoods. Their forgetful functors agree, so the source diagram is the target diagram precomposed with its opposite. Mathlib colimit.pre defines the comparison, colimit.ι_pre gives its rule, and Functor.Final.colimit_pre_isIso gives invertibility. Point.presheafFiber_hom_ext proves uniqueness; in Type, isIso_iff_bijective gives bijectivity.

theorem geometricPointMorphism_addCommGrp_stalk
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (s' : Spec (.of k') ⟶ S)
    (a : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) (ha : a ≫ s' = s) :
    ∀ F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max u v},
      let b : Over.mk s ⟶ Over.mk s' := Over.homMk a ha
      let α : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber ⟶ (pointSmallEtale s).fiber :=
        Functor.whiskerLeft (Etale.forget S) (coyoneda.map b.op)
      let P := fun f : (pointSmallEtale s').sheafFiber.obj F ⟶
          (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F ↦
        ∀ (U : S.Etale) (t : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber.obj U),
          (pointSmallEtale s').toPresheafFiber U t F.obj ≫ f =
            (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber U (α.app U t) F.obj
      (∃! f, P f) ∧ ∀ f, P f → IsIso f
